feed.title: Daylight: Zoning cases, District 11
feed.subtitle: Each zoning case whose agenda prints District 11, at each meeting it appears at. Cases that print no district are in the Rezoning feed. Daylight is an independent, unofficial site run by gnoshcodes LLC. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by the City of Clarksville, Montgomery County, the Clarksville-Montgomery County School System (CMCSS), or the Clarksville-Montgomery County Regional Planning Commission. The official record held by each body controls.
